reviews_5s:
Work great, fills Coleman Lanterns easily with no spills, fine filter may get loose; great customer service. They are not too tiny--some reviewers felt they were getting a toy key-chain funnel that was too tiny. You need this tiny size and the straighter walls to fill the fluid into a lantern or a stove without spilling.Great little funnel. Sturdily built. Will last a lifetime.This is a small, small funnel. It is best suited for bottles of containers with tiny openings. It seems well made.Have you ever poured something into a small hole and thought there must be an easier way? Well buddy, sit down and just try to hold yourself together.

You don’t have to spill that thing you were pouring into a small hole this is effing genius. It’s based on the belief that you can slowing change the direction, focus speed of materials from straight down to sideways straight down but over the smaller hole.

Did I just go too fast?

Okay so, this device changes direction or ‘funnels’ if you will material from a larger hole to a smaller one. You’re not going to see this device on late night advertisements, but it’s so practical and handy…. It might well deserve to be.

Five effing stars with five effing high fives.

Are you ready to walk around your group of friends hearing congratulations on all the success you’ve had ‘funneling’ objects into smaller holes? You better buy it and keep an effing glove on that high five hand.I carrie these when campingPerfect dimensions for refilling my Coleman lantern. Has a fine-mesh screen to stop debris.So this funnel is not for changing the oil in your truck it is perfectly made to fill camp lanterns and other camp equipment that take liquid fuel. It does an amazing job for what it is intended for. I also use it to refill tiki torches. I also found an alternate use. I bought a second funnel and popped out the mesh strainer so I could use it to reload my kids red Ryder BB guns and it also works perfectly for that. Usually it is a huge pain to reload BB guns but this can load 500 BBS very quickly. Great camp fuel funnel and BB gun loader.Works great for reloading, smooth for easy powder flow.Good for fuel and a small ne ked storage container.Essential when refueling liquid gas to a camping stove. Has a screen to filter out debris. Funnel’s good point is that it is compact, easier to fit with camping gear.
reviews_1s:
Screen fell out of item while I was opening the amazon package it was delivered in. Chain to clip to lantern or gas can is cheap and literally fell apart. Would not recommend. Buy a metal funnel - these are overpriced and poorly manufactured.Smaller than advertisedsize of a thimbleThere is nothing wrong with the funnel accept that I had done a search for a gas funnel and this popped up and I didnt catch it. I was in a hurry to get a funnel and ordered it. LOL. At the prices of gas now, maybe this was an omen it would be all Id get to use!My fault for not reading how tiny. It won't even sit straight. It us about 2 inches across. Fall out of milk container I was using to collect rainwater. About as big around as the size of your gas can lid, or maybe even smaller? Too lightweight to trust pouring into without one hand holding the funnel. If tiny is what you need go for it.Study dimensions before buying. It literally comes with a little chain to put on your car keys.The picture did not do the buyer justice!
Extremely Small, & very tricky to tell the difference in the photo.This product was smaller than what I expected. Wished I had not ordered it.Received without the screen!I didn’t realize it is a toy version of a real funnel. Do not waste your time. Just buy one from an auto store.
